args.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trade_date, close, adj_close
  FROM market.daily_prices
  WHERE ticker = 'NVDA'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d) AS latest_date,
  (SELECT close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_close,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM d WHERE trade_date <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS ytd_start_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM d WHERE trade_date <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS ytd_start_adj,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT adj_close FROM d WHERE trade_date <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) - 1) * 100::numeric, 2)) AS ytd_return_pct,
  (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d WHERE trade_date >= date_trunc('year', (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d))::date) AS first_trade_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS first_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) - 1) * 100::numeric, 2)) AS since_first_avail_pct,
  (SELECT min(trade_date) FROM d) AS data_start

args.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trade_date, adj_close
  FROM market.daily_prices
  WHERE ticker = 'NVDA'
    AND trade_date <= '2026-11-12'
    AND extract(year FROM trade_date) >= 2025
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT trade_date, adj_close,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn_desc,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY trade_date ASC)  AS rn_asc
  FROM d
)
SELECT
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)  AS latest_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)  AS latest_adj,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 2)  AS prior_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 2)  AS prior_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 2)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS one_day_pct,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 22) AS one_month_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 22) AS one_month_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 22)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS one_month_pct,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 253) AS one_year_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 253) AS one_year_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 253)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS one_year_pct,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_asc = 1) AS earliest_in_window,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_asc = 1) AS earliest_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_asc = 1)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS since_earliest_pct,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ranked) AS trading_days_in_window

events.content:
1. Plan 2–4 focused queries before searching: the core question, plus the angles a good answer needs (numbers, dates, who/what, opposing views).
2. Use the web search tool (`tavily_tavily_search`). Search in English, and also in Vietnamese when the topic is about Vietnam or the user writes Vietnamese.
3. For news or anything that changes, prefer recent results and note each result's date. Say "as of <date>" in the finding.
4. When a result looks important but its snippet is thin, read the page with the extract tool (`tavily_tavily_extract`) instead of guessing from the snippet. Extract at most 2–3 pages.
5. Prefer primary or reputable sources (official sites, filings, major outlets, papers) over blogs and forums. When sources disagree, record both, each with its source.
6. Stop once the question is covered. Don't keep searching for marginal details, because every search costs a step.
7. Every finding gets the source id of the page it came from (not the site's home page) and a quote copied from that page's result.

# Nvidia Stock Is Up 19% in 2026. Time to Sell or Load Up?

Gian Estrada • 5 minute read

Reviewed by: Gian Estrada

Last updated Sep 26, 2026

nhat82125 from pixabay and ChiccoDodiFC from Getty Images via Canva

## Key Takeaways

 Nvidia stock has climbed 19% YTD to $225, a gain that trails a Q2 in which revenue more than doubled YoY to $96B.
 The stock’s P/E has shrunk 25.8% over the past year while EPS grew 59.5%.
 Management guided to ~70% revenue growth in fiscal 2028 and called that figure supply-constrained, while cutting its gross margin outlook to a 71%-72% trough in Q4 as memory costs climb.
 TIKR’s mid-case model values Nvidia stock at $661 by January 2031, implying 194% total return, or 28% annualized. [...] Nvidia’s earnings outran its share price by a wide margin over the past year. Check whether the market is right to hold back. Track Nvidia stock on TIKR for free →

## Why Nvidia Stock Has Gained 19% This Year as Its Revenue Doubled

nvidia stock price

NVDA Stock Price: Year to Date (TIKR)

Nvidia (NVDA) stock closed at $225 on Friday, September 25, up 19% since the start of 2026. That is a respectable gain, and a modest one for a company whose second-quarter revenue more than doubled year over year to $96 billion. [...] The path there was rough. Nvidia stock bottomed below $170 in late March, then topped $230 in mid-May after first-quarter adjusted EPS of $1.87 beat the $1.76 consensus. It gave much of that back by late July, sliding toward $190, before an August 26 report with adjusted EPS of $2.22 against a $2.10 estimate pushed shares back above $220.

Over the past year, Nvidia’s EPS grew 59.5% while the stock’s price-to-earnings multiple compressed 25.8%. 5. Prefer primary or reputable sources (official sites, filings, major outlets, papers) over blogs and forums. When sources disagree, record both, each with its source.

agreements: NVDA closed at $166.19 on 2026-11-12, down 4.34% in the session.
2026 year-to-date total return is about -10.7% as of 2026-11-12.
The 2026 closing high was $239.24 on 2026-10-06 and the intraday 52-week high is $243.37.
The stock now sits roughly 30% below its high.
Both describe the same shape: a rally into an early-October peak followed by a steep multi-week slide.

differences.explanation: The database profile field is stamped 2026-11-11, before the 12 Nov session in which the stock traded down to $148.80; a one-day gap fits a ~10% move in the low but not a different definition of the range.
The two figures are one session apart, and that session fell 4.34%, which accounts for most of the ~3% gap; residual difference comes from share-count and price-source conventions.
One side measures dividend-adjusted total return through 12 Nov, the other price-only return through the 10 Nov close; the dividend adjustment plus the two extra down days cover the 1.2-point gap.
Different 30-day windows and price-only versus total-return bases explain a gap of this size.

conflicts.issue: A ~30% gap is too large for the one-day date difference, neither side says which forward EPS estimate or fiscal year its ratio uses, and the research side gives no as-of date for its figure.

WITH d AS (
  SELECT trade_date, open, high, low, close, adj_close, volume
  FROM market.daily_prices
  WHERE ticker = 'NVDA' AND trade_date BETWEEN (DATE '2026-11-12' - INTERVAL '365 days') AND DATE '2026-11-12'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min(trade_date) FROM d) AS window_start,
  (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d) AS window_end,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM d) AS sessions,
  (SELECT min(low) FROM d) AS min_intraday_low,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM d ORDER BY low ASC, trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS min_low_date,
  (SELECT min(close) FROM d) AS min_close,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM d ORDER BY close ASC, trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS min_close_date,
  (SELECT max(high) FROM d) AS max_intraday_high,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM d ORDER BY high DESC, trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS max_high_date,
  (SELECT max(close) FROM d) AS max_close,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM d ORDER BY close DESC, trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS max_close_date

SELECT trade_date, open, high, low, close, adj_close, volume
FROM market.daily_prices
WHERE ticker = 'NVDA' AND trade_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-02' AND DATE '2026-11-12'
ORDER BY trade_date

WITH d AS (
  SELECT trade_date, open, high, low, close, adj_close, volume
  FROM market.daily_prices
  WHERE ticker = 'NVDA' AND trade_date BETWEEN (DATE '2026-11-12' - INTERVAL '365 days') AND DATE '2026-11-12'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min(trade_date) FROM d) AS window_start,
  (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d) AS window_end,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM d) AS sessions,
  (SELECT min(low) FROM d) AS min_intraday_low,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM d ORDER BY low ASC, trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS min_low_date,

**My recomputation (source: `market.daily_prices`, all USD, end-of-day, window 2025-11-12 → 2026-11-12)**

| Metric | Value | As of (trade_date) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 52-week intraday low | **$148.80** | 2026-11-12 |
| 52-week lowest close | **$165.17** (adj $164.79) | 2026-03-30 |
| Prior 52-week intraday low | $164.27 | 2026-03-30 |
| 52-week intraday high | $243.37 | 2026-10-06 |
| 52-week highest close | $239.24 | 2026-10-06 |
| 2026-11-12 session | open $151.01 / high $167.14 / low $148.80 / close $166.19 | 2026-11-12 |
| 2026-11-12 volume | 742,789,000 (≈5.7× the 131.1M 3-month average) | 2026-11-12 |
| Last lower low before this | $135.40 | 2025-06-02 |
| `market.stocks.week52_low` / `week52_high` | $164.27 / $243.37 | updated_at 2026-11-11 13:39 UTC |

**How the inputs compare with my source**

| Input | Their value | My finding |
| --- | --- | --- |
| t2: intraday low $148.80, 52-week range $148.80–$243.37 | $148.80 | Confirmed — matches my recomputation exactly |
| t1: 52-week range $164.27 – $243.37 | $164.27 low | Does not match through 2026-11-12; that is the stale profile value (as of 2026-11-11), superseded by $148.80 |
| t2: "lowest since June 2025" | June 2025 | Confirmed — last lower intraday low was $135.40 on 2025-06-02 |
| t2: volume 747.7M vs ~131.1M average | 747.7M | Average confirmed (131.1M, 2026-08-12→11-11); my row shows 742,789,000, ~5M below their figure |
| t2: record close $239.24 on 6 Oct, intraday high $243.37 | $239.24 / $243.37 | Confirmed both |
| t2: down ~30% from all-time high | −30% | Confirmed: −30.53% ($239.24 → $166.19) |

| t1: latest close $166.19, −4.34% on the day, 1-month −24.90%, 1-year −13.76%, 2026 closing low $164.79 | as listed | All confirmed against my rows |
| t2: market cap $3.954T | $3.954T | Does not match our profile: $4,078,186,790,912 as of updated_at 2026-11-11, which is struck at the 11 Nov close of $173.73; at the 11-12 close of $166.19 the implied cap is ≈$3.90T (my arithmetic, not a stored figure) |

What we could not check: the news half is outside my sources — I have only the PostgreSQL `market` schema (daily OHLCV and company stats), no news feed or filings, so every headline, the CEO transition, the board probe and the 17 Nov earnings date come from the team's research, not from anything I verified. FINDINGS:
- No permanent CEO successor named as of 13 Nov 2026: Nvidia's 12 Nov release says only that the board "is initiating a search" and will consider internal and external candidates. [source: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition#:~:text=The%20Board%20is%20initiating,permanent%20Chief%20Executive%20Officer]
- Colette Kress remains interim CEO while keeping the CFO title "until a permanent successor has been named"; Harvey C. Jones is the board's first-ever chair. [source: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition#:~:text=until%20a%20permanent%20successor%20has%20been%20named]
- 13 Nov 2026 (Bloomberg): Nvidia "has tapped an outside firm to identify potential candidates"; Kress serving as interim CEO. [source: Watch Nvidia CEO Search: Who Are the Candidates for Permanent Role? - Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-13/nvidia-ceo-who-are-the-candidates-for-permanent-role-video | passage: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-13/nvidia-ceo-who-are-the-candidates-for-permanent-role-video#:~:text=The%20company%20has%20tapped,to%20identify%20potential%20candidates]
- Bloomberg reported 11 Nov that the board was working with the outside firm and weighing a temporary CEO; Apple hardware chief Johny Srouji was cited as under consideration. [source: Nvidia Has Hired an Outside Firm to Find Jensen Huang’s Replacement | https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-hired-outside-firm-jensen-121724383.html | passage: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-hired-outside-firm-jensen-121724383.html#:~:text=Apple%27s%20Johny%20Srouji%20is%20reportedly%20under%20consideration]
- Names in circulation (unconfirmed by Nvidia): Ian Buck, Rene Haas (Arm), Lisa Su (AMD), Chris Malachowsky, Madison Huang. [source: Nvidia names Kress interim CEO after Jensen Huang resigns | https://americanbazaaronline.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-names-kress-interim-ceo-after-jensen-huang-resigns-492157 | passage: https://americanbazaaronline.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-names-kress-interim-ceo-after-jensen-huang-resigns-492157#:~:text=These%20names%20have%20not,by%20Nvidia%20as%20candidates]
- Board statement on the intelligence probe: the latest official one found is dated 10 Nov 2026 — independent directors retained ex-acting SDNY US Attorney Joon H. Kim and Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. [source: Statement From the Independent Members of the NVIDIA Board | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-the-independent-members-of-the-nvidia-board | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-the-independent-members-of-the-nvidia-board#:~:text=retained%20former%20acting%20U.S.,York%20Joon%20H.%20Kim]
- No board statement dated after 12 Nov 2026 and no probe findings, deadline or disclosure commitment found; the 12 Nov transition release does not address the investigation. [source: Jensen Huang Resigns; Nvidia Names Kress Interim CEO | Frontier | https://thedefiant.io/frontier/ai/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-names-kress-interim-ceo | passage: https://thedefiant.io/frontier/ai/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-names-kress-interim-ceo#:~:text=The%20filing%20does%20not,investigation%20announced%20Nov.%208]
- The 8 Nov board statement opened the probe, said it had "no reason to believe" national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, and promised "further updates as appropriate." [source: Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors#:~:text=will%20provide%20further%20updates%20as%20appropriate]
- Q3 FY2027 results have NOT been reported: Nvidia confirmed on 12 Nov it will report "on Tuesday, November 17, at approximately 1:20 p.m. PT... as previously scheduled," call at 2 p.m. PT. [source: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition#:~:text=on%20Tuesday%2C%20November%2017%2C,approximately%201:20%20p.m.%20PT]
- Quarter covered ended 25 Oct 2026; date originally set 28 Oct 2026. [source: NVIDIA Sets Conference Call for Third-Quarter Financial Results | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873 | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873#:~:text=third%20quarter%20of%20fiscal,ended%20October%2025%2C%202026]
- Guidance for the quarter: revenue $108.0B ±2%, GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin 74.0% ±50bps, no China data-center compute assumed. [source: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027 | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027#:~:text=Revenue%20is%20expected%20to,plus%20or%20minus%202%25]
- Consensus is ~$109B revenue, in line with guidance; Oppenheimer expects "fundamentals to take a backseat near term" with a "lingering share overhang." [source: Nvidia stock drops for 6th week, shedding $1.6 trillion in market cap | https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-stock-jensen-affair-ai.html | passage: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-stock-jensen-affair-ai.html#:~:text=we%20expect%20fundamentals%20to,a%20backseat%20near%20term]
- Stock: shares fell 4.3% on 12 Nov, leaving an 11% weekly loss, the sixth straight weekly drop (longest since 2012), -29% from the peak, ~$1.6T of market cap gone, below Apple. [source: Nvidia stock drops for 6th week, shedding $1.6 trillion in market cap | https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-stock-jensen-affair-ai.html | passage: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-stock-jensen-affair-ai.html#:~:text=bringing%20their%20loss%20for%20the%20week%20to%2011%25]
- 13 Nov: NVDA down 13% over the past week, "trading at $165" per spread-betting markets; Asian shares mixed as investors assessed the fallout. [source: Daily Stock Market Report (Fri 13th Nov 2026) - Agenda | Stockopedia | https://www.stockopedia.com/content/daily-stock-market-report-fri-13th-nov-2026-placeholder-1060620 | passage: https://www.stockopedia.com/content/daily-stock-market-report-fri-13th-nov-2026-placeholder-1060620#:~:text=down%2013%25%20over%20the%20past%20week]
- Valuation/targets after the news: ~12x forward earnings, cheapest since 2012 (Reuters, 13 Nov); Morningstar cut fair value to $250 from $310; D.A. Davidson's Luria cut his target to $200 from $300, kept Buy. [source: Nvidia PE Ratio Hits 12x, a 14-Year Low [2026] | https://shattered.io/nvidia-pe-ratio-12x-14-year-low-huang-exit-ai-worries-2026 | passage: https://shattered.io/nvidia-pe-ratio-12x-14-year-low-huang-exit-ai-worries-2026#:~:text=roughly%2012%20times%20expected,forward%20valuation%20since%202012]
- Cross-check of t2 inputs I could verify: record close $239.24 on 6 Oct 2026 and a 52-week low still shown as $164.27 (pre-crash) on investor.nvidia.com both check out; CNBC's 4.3% / $1.6T / sixth-week figures match t2, though the CNBC piece is dated 13 Nov, not 12 Nov. [source: NVIDIA Corporation - Stock Quote & Chart | https://investor.nvidia.com/stock-info/stock-quote-and-chart/default.aspx]
- GAPS: no source found for a permanent CEO appointment, any board statement dated 13 Nov, probe findings, or Q3 results; a single low-quality blog claims a Kress all-hands on 18 Nov and Huang congressional testimony before Thanksgiving — unverified, we could not confirm it.

We can pin down the as-of dates and what the fields behave like, but not the forward-EPS definition: the `market` schema documents `market_cap` only as "in the stock's currency" and says nothing at all about how `forward_pe` is computed, and there is no forward-EPS column anywhere in the database, so which estimate (current FY, next FY, or next-twelve-months) sits behind it is undocumented and not recoverable from our sources.

| Field | What our source actually says | As-of | What I verified |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `market_cap` | Schema comment: "market_cap and revenue are in the stock's currency." No formula given. | `updated_at` 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC, identical for all 200 rows | Behaves like shares outstanding × share price: dividing by the 2026-11-11 close implies 15,993,481–23,474,280,728 shares across the 200 tickers. Exact share counts aren't in the schema, so the precise price snapshot can't be confirmed. |
| `forward_pe` | Column name only — no definition, no stated EPS horizon. | `updated_at` 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC | It is price ÷ a *forward* EPS estimate, not the `eps` column: 16 tickers with negative `eps` and NULL `trailing_pe` still carry a positive `forward_pe` (COIN −2.77 → 54.71; INTC −2.35 → 32.47; NET −0.67 → 165.35), and 3 are negative where the forward estimate itself is negative (MRNA −58.65, RBLX −40.19, RIVN −7.76). `forward_pe` < `trailing_pe` for 165 of 200. |
| Price data | `daily_prices`, end-of-day OHLCV, 248,236 rows, 200 tickers, 2021-11-11 → 2026-11-12 | Latest `trade_date` 2026-11-12 (199 of 200 tickers have that session) | The multiples are stamped one session *before* the latest close, so they are stale relative to 2026-11-12 prices. |

Two caveats on internal consistency. First, `trailing_pe` is not exactly reproducible from the same row: close(2026-11-11) ÷ `eps` lands within 0.05 of `trailing_pe` for only 33 of 200 tickers, with a median ratio of 1.0204 (1.0183 using the 2026-11-12 close) — roughly a 2% mismatch. Second, for NVDA the forward P/E of 10.6042 implies a forward EPS of about $15.67 using the 2026-11-12 close of $166.19, or $16.38 using the 2026-11-11 close of $173.73, against trailing `eps` of $7.91; that $15.67–$16.38 figure is my arithmetic, not a stored value.

Checking the other input (t1) against my queries:

| t1 claim | My value | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Market cap $4,078,186,790,912, updated_at 2026-11-11 | Same, USD | Matches |
| Trailing / forward P/E 21.35 / 10.60, updated_at 2026-11-11 | 21.3515 / 10.6042, updated_at 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC | Matches |
| Latest close $166.19 on 2026-11-12 | Same | Matches |
| 2025 year-end adj close $186.06; YTD −10.68% | 186.0646; −10.68% | Matches |
| 2026 adj high $239.24, adj

low $164.79, drawdown −30.5% | 239.24, 164.7933, −30.53% | Values match; I did not verify the 2026-10-06 and 2026-03-30 dates |
| Latest session move −4.34% | 173.73 → 166.19 = −4.34% | Matches |
| No news, filings, or web access in our sources | `market` holds only OHLCV and company stats — no text, filings, or news fields | Matches |

I could not check t1's 52-week range ($164.27–$243.37), revenue ($302,970,011,648), profit margin (63.66%), 1-month return
(−24.90%), or 1-year return (−13.76%), as I didn't query those columns. On the user's news question, we have nothing: no source in this database covers NVIDIA headlines, and we won't guess.

FINDINGS:
- Checked the disputed figure: $4.078T is the 11 Nov 2026 close value, not 12 Nov — StatMuse lists 11 Nov close $173.73 × 23,474,280,728 shares = $4,078,186,790,875. [source: S9a1b | "November 11 2026 | $173.73 | 339,214,781 | 23,474,280,728 | $4,078,186,790,875.44"]
- StatMuse's same table shows 10 Nov close $168.89 → $3,964,571,272,151.92, so its series is one day stale and never struck 12 Nov. [source: S9a1b | "November 10 2026 | $168.89 | 429,273,219 | 23,474,280,728 | $3,964,571,272,151.92"]
- 12 Nov 2026 close was $166.19, down $7.54 (-4.34%) from $173.73, after a ~14% intraday plunge to $148.80; volume 747.97M vs 131.49M average. [source: S7f5a | "Regular market price: 166.19 -7.54 (-4.34%) as of 2026-11-12 21:00 UTC"]
- Applying Nvidia's SEC-filing share count (24.1B, 10-Q cover dated 21 Aug 2026) to the 12 Nov close gives ≈$4.00T; StockTitan states it outright. [source: S7ff7 | "Nvidia, its $166.19 close, about $4.0 trillion"]
- StockTitan's intraday version of the same math: $163.94 × 24.1B ≈ $3.95T at 3:02 p.m. ET on 12 Nov. [source: S7ff7 | "Nvidia, $163.94 times 24.1 billion shares as of August 21, 2026"]
- So the true 12 Nov close market cap is ≈$3.95–4.01T depending

on share count (24.1B SEC cover vs 24.15B data vendors), not $3.954T-as-of-12-Nov and not $4.078T. [source: S67c8 | "NVIDIA has 24.15 billion shares outstanding"]
- Yahoo Finance quote page shows market cap $4,012,989,743,104 at the 12

Nov close, plus a separate "non diluted market cap" of $4,195,058,310,000. [source: S7f5a | "Market cap | 4,012,989,743,104"]
- CoinGlass also puts 12 Nov close market cap at ≈$4.01T on price $166.19. [source: S812e | "NVIDIA Corporation has a market capitalization of approximately $4.01T"]
- The $3.954T figure is FinanceCharts' own snapshot paired with its 12 Nov YTD row; its share-count basis is not disclosed, so it is ~1.5% below the SEC-count value. [source: S544f | "11/12/2026 | -10.68% | -14.04% | 242.83% | 449.28%"]
- Recommendation: report "just under/around $4.0T (≈$3.95–4.01T) at the 12 Nov 2026 close"; do not report $4.078T, which is struck at the 11 Nov close of $173.73.
- Corroborating the level: CNBC said the stock "hovered just under $4 trillion in market cap" on 12 Nov after paring a >10% drop. [source: Sc022 | "The stock hovered just under $4 trillion in market cap"]
- Bloomberg/Business Times framed it as market cap falling "below US$4 trillion for the first time since 2025," with as much as $601B erased at the -14% low. [source: Sc0cc | "taking the chipmaker's market capitalisation below US$4 trillion for the first time since 2025"]
- Year-to-date: total return -10.68% as of 12 Nov 2026 (TTM -14.04%, 30-day -27.28%); price-only 2026 return -9.44% as of the 10 Nov close (slickcharts, not dividend-adjusted). [source: S544f | "11/12/2026 | -10.68% | -14.04%"]
- Prior 2026 gains: +19% YTD at $225 on 25 Sep 2026 and ~+17% YTD on 27 Oct 2026; record close $239.24 on 6 Oct 2026, intraday 52-week high $243.37. [source: Sbefe | "2026 | -9.44"]
- Sixth straight weekly loss, ~$1.6T of value gone — longest losing streak since 2012; stock ~31% below its record close. [source: S7ff7 | "Nvidia about 31% below its record: its $166.19 close on November 12 against its record close of $239.24 on October 6, 2026"]
- 12 Nov 2026: "Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board,

effective immediately"; CFO Colette Kress interim CEO (keeps CFO role), Harvey C. Jones first-ever board chair. [source: Sb878 | "Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately"]
- 8 Nov 2026 board statement: independent investigation by a committee of independent directors with outside counsel into reporting Huang "has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort." [source: Sa24f | "the target of a foreign intelligence effort"]
- Trigger: WSJ/NYT/FT reporting on two extramarital affairs, one with a woman US intelligence concluded was a Chinese spy; Reuters reported a relationship with a second Nvidia employee. [source: S893d | "Huang has admitted to having an affair, reportedly

with a Chinese executive"]
- 13 Nov: Elon Musk said hiring Huang "would be an honor"; Fortune reports Nvidia lost $450B of market value in the days after Huang admitted the affair. [source: S1c1d | "Nvidia lost $450 billion in market value in the days after Huang admitted to an affair"]
- 13 Nov: Asian shares fell on the fallout; Nvidia's Asian supply chain (TSMC, SK hynix, Samsung) preparing for "life after Huang"; forward PE ~12x, cheapest since 2012 per Reuters. [source: S6b2e | "The chips Nvidia will ship over the next"]
- Analyst moves: Bernstein cut its target to $200 from $400; Citigroup's Atif Malik and Papa

Sylla cut to $225 from $285. [source: S0c44 | "Bernstein slashed its NVIDIA price target to $200 from $400"]
- Wedbush's Dan Ives: worth $300/share with Huang as CEO, $225 without. [source: Sc022 | "We believe Nvidia's value is $300 per share with Jensen as CEO and $225 per share without Jensen as CEO"]
- Q3 FY2027 results still due Tue 17 Nov 2026 after the US close (~1:20 p.m. PT release, 2 p.m. PT call), Kress's first as interim CEO; consensus ~$108.8–109B revenue, ~$2.47 adjusted EPS. [source: Sb878 | "report its

third-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results on Tuesday, November 17"]
- Kress plans a company-wide meeting on 18 Nov; three House committee chairs had asked Huang for a closed-door briefing that day. [source: S4047 | "three House committee chairs had asked Huang for a closed-door briefing on November 18"]
- GAPS: No single source states a 12 Nov

-close market cap to the dollar; the range comes from share-count differences (24.1B SEC cover vs 24.15B vendor). Macrotrends shows $4.187T "as of November 13, 2026" but the page would not load for verification. No permanent CEO successor named, no board statement after 12 Nov, and no published findings from the intelligence probe.

args.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trade_date, close, adj_close
  FROM market.daily_prices
  WHERE ticker = 'NVDA'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d) AS latest_date,
  (SELECT close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_close,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM d WHERE trade_date <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS ytd_start_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM d WHERE trade_date <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS ytd_start_adj,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT adj_close FROM d WHERE trade_date <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) - 1) * 100::numeric, 2)) AS ytd_return_pct,
  (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d WHERE trade_date >= date_trunc('year', (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d))::date) AS first_trade_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS first_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) - 1) * 100::numeric, 2)) AS since_first_avail_pct,
  (SELECT min(trade_date) FROM d) AS data_start

SELECT ticker, name, sector, industry, market_cap, currency, trailing_pe, forward_pe, eps, beta, week52_high, week52_low, revenue, profit_margin, updated_at
FROM market.stocks
WHERE ticker = 'NVDA'

args.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trade_date, adj_close
  FROM market.daily_prices
  WHERE ticker = 'NVDA'
    AND trade_date <= '2026-11-12'
    AND extract(year FROM trade_date) >= 2025
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT trade_date, adj_close,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn_desc,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY trade_date ASC)  AS rn_asc
  FROM d
)
SELECT
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)  AS latest_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)  AS latest_adj,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 2)  AS prior_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 2)  AS prior_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 2)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS one_day_pct,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 22) AS one_month_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 22) AS one_month_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 22)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS one_month_pct,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 253) AS one_year_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 253) AS one_year_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 253)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS one_year_pct,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_asc = 1) AS earliest_in_window,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_asc = 1) AS earliest_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_asc = 1)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS since_earliest_pct,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ranked) AS trading_days_in_window

  FROM market.daily_prices
  WHERE ticker = 'NVDA'
    AND trade_date <= '2026-11-12'

ranked AS (

  FROM d

SELECT

FINDINGS:
- No permanent CEO successor named as of 13 Nov 2026: Nvidia's 12 Nov release says only that the board "is initiating a search" and will consider internal and external candidates. [source: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition#:~:text=The%20Board%20is%20initiating,permanent%20Chief%20Executive%20Officer]
- Colette Kress remains interim CEO while keeping the CFO title "until a permanent successor has been named"; Harvey C. Jones is the board's first-ever chair. [source: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition#:~:text=until%20a%20permanent%20successor%20has%20been%20named]
- 13 Nov 2026 (Bloomberg): Nvidia "has tapped an outside firm to identify potential candidates"; Kress serving as interim CEO. [source: Watch Nvidia CEO Search: Who Are the Candidates for Permanent Role? - Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-13/nvidia-ceo-who-are-the-candidates-for-permanent-role-video | passage: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-13/nvidia-ceo-who-are-the-candidates-for-permanent-role-video#:~:text=The%20company%20has%20tapped,to%20identify%20potential%20candidates]
- Bloomberg reported 11 Nov that the board was working with the outside firm and weighing a temporary CEO; Apple hardware chief Johny Srouji was cited as under consideration. [source: Nvidia Has Hired an Outside Firm to Find Jensen Huang’s Replacement | https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-hired-outside-firm-jensen-121724383.html | passage: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-hired-outside-firm-jensen-121724383.html#:~:text=Apple%27s%20Johny%20Srouji%20is%20reportedly%20under%20consideration]
- Names in circulation (unconfirmed by Nvidia): Ian Buck, Rene Haas (Arm), Lisa Su (AMD), Chris Malachowsky, Madison Huang. [source: Nvidia names Kress interim CEO after Jensen Huang resigns | https://americanbazaaronline.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-names-kress-interim-ceo-after-jensen-huang-resigns-492157 | passage: https://americanbazaaronline.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-names-kress-interim-ceo-after-jensen-huang-resigns-492157#:~:text=These%20names%20have%20not,by%20Nvidia%20as%20candidates]
- Board statement on the intelligence probe: the latest official one found is dated 10 Nov 2026 — independent directors retained ex-acting SDNY US Attorney Joon H. Kim and Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz. [source: Statement From the Independent Members of the NVIDIA Board | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-the-independent-members-of-the-nvidia-board | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-the-independent-members-of-the-nvidia-board#:~:text=retained%20former%20acting%20U.S.,York%20Joon%20H.%20Kim]
- No board statement dated after 12 Nov 2026 and no probe findings, deadline or disclosure commitment found; the 12 Nov transition release does not address the investigation. [source: Jensen Huang Resigns; Nvidia Names Kress Interim CEO | Frontier | https://thedefiant.io/frontier/ai/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-names-kress-interim-ceo | passage: https://thedefiant.io/frontier/ai/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-names-kress-interim-ceo#:~:text=The%20filing%20does%20not,investigation%20announced%20Nov.%208]
- The 8 Nov board statement opened the probe, said it had "no reason to believe" national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, and promised "further updates as appropriate." [source: Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors#:~:text=will%20provide%20further%20updates%20as%20appropriate]
- Q3 FY2027 results have NOT been reported: Nvidia confirmed on 12 Nov it will report "on Tuesday, November 17, at approximately 1:20 p.m. PT... as previously scheduled," call at 2 p.m. PT. [source: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition#:~:text=on%20Tuesday%2C%20November%2017%2C,approximately%201:20%20p.m.%20PT]

- Consensus is ~$109B revenue, in line with guidance; Oppenheimer expects "fundamentals to take a backseat near term" with a "lingering share overhang." - Stock: shares fell 4.3% on 12 Nov, leaving an 11% weekly loss, the sixth straight weekly drop (longest since 2012), -29% from the peak, ~$1.6T of market cap gone, below Apple. [source: Nvidia stock drops for 6th week, shedding $1.6 trillion in market cap | https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-stock-jensen-affair-ai.html | passage: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-stock-jensen-affair-ai.html#:~:text=bringing%20their%20loss%20for%20the%20week%20to%2011%25]
- 13 Nov: NVDA down 13% over the past week, "trading at $165" per spread-betting markets; Asian shares mixed as investors assessed the fallout. [source: Daily Stock Market Report (Fri 13th Nov 2026) - Agenda | Stockopedia | https://www.stockopedia.com/content/daily-stock-market-report-fri-13th-nov-2026-placeholder-1060620 | passage: https://www.stockopedia.com/content/daily-stock-market-report-fri-13th-nov-2026-placeholder-1060620#:~:text=down%2013%25%20over%20the%20past%20week]
- Valuation/targets after the news: ~12x forward earnings, cheapest since 2012 (Reuters, 13 Nov); Morningstar cut fair value to $250 from $310; D.A. Davidson's Luria cut his target to $200 from $300, kept Buy. [source: Nvidia PE Ratio Hits 12x, a 14-Year Low [2026] | https://shattered.io/nvidia-pe-ratio-12x-14-year-low-huang-exit-ai-worries-2026 | passage: https://shattered.io/nvidia-pe-ratio-12x-14-year-low-huang-exit-ai-worries-2026#:~:text=roughly%2012%20times%20expected,forward%20valuation%20since%202012]
- Cross-check of t2 inputs I could verify: record close $239.24 on 6 Oct 2026 and a 52-week low still shown as $164.27 (pre-crash) on investor.nvidia.com both check out; CNBC's 4.3% / $1.6T / sixth-week figures match t2, though the CNBC piece is dated 13 Nov, not 12 Nov. [source: NVIDIA Corporation - Stock Quote & Chart | https://investor.nvidia.com/stock-info/stock-quote-and-chart/default.aspx]
- GAPS: no source found for a permanent CEO appointment, any board statement dated 13 Nov, probe findings, or Q3 results; a single low-quality blog claims a Kress all-hands on 18 Nov and Huang congressional testimony before Thanksgiving — unverified, we could not confirm it.

activity.text:
We can pin down the as-of dates and what the fields behave like, but not the forward-EPS definition: the `market` schema documents `market_cap` only as "in the stock's currency" and says nothing at all about how `forward_pe` is computed, and there is no forward-EPS column anywhere in the database, so which estimate (current FY, next FY, or next-twelve-months) sits behind it is undocumented and not recoverable from our sources.

| Field | What our source actually says | As-of | What I verified |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `market_cap` | Schema comment: "market_cap and revenue are in the stock's currency." No formula given. | `updated_at` 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC, identical for all 200 rows | Behaves like shares outstanding × share price: dividing by the 2026-11-11 close implies 15,993,481–23,474,280,728 shares across the 200 tickers. Exact share counts aren't in the schema, so the precise price snapshot can't be confirmed. |
| `forward_pe` | Column name only — no definition, no stated EPS horizon. | `updated_at` 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC | It is price ÷ a *forward* EPS estimate, not the `eps` column: 16 tickers with negative `eps` and NULL `trailing_pe` still carry a positive `forward_pe` (COIN −2.77 → 54.71; INTC −2.35 → 32.47; NET −0.67 → 165.35), and 3 are negative where the forward estimate itself is negative (MRNA −58.65, RBLX −40.19, RIVN −7.76). `forward_pe` < `trailing_pe` for 165 of 200. |
| Price data | `daily_prices`, end-of-day OHLCV, 248,236 rows, 200 tickers, 2021-11-11 → 2026-11-12 | Latest `trade_date` 2026-11-12 (199 of 200 tickers have that session) | The multiples are stamped one session *before* the latest close, so they are stale relative to 2026-11-12 prices. |

Two caveats on internal consistency. First, `trailing_pe` is not exactly reproducible from the same row: close(2026-11-11) ÷ `eps` lands within 0.05 of `trailing_pe` for only 33 of 200 tickers, with a median ratio of 1.0204 (1.0183 using the 2026-11-12 close) — roughly a 2% mismatch. Second, for NVDA the forward P/E of 10.6042 implies a forward EPS of about $15.67 using the 2026-11-12 close of $166.19, or $16.38 using the 2026-11-11 close of $173.73, against trailing `eps` of $7.91; that $15.67–$16.38 figure is my arithmetic, not a stored value.

Checking the other input (t1) against my queries:

| t1 claim | My value | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Market cap $4,078,186,790,912, updated_at 2026-11-11 | Same, USD | Matches |
| Trailing / forward P/E 21.35 / 10.60, updated_at 2026-11-11 | 21.3515 / 10.6042, updated_at 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC | Matches |
| Latest close $166.19 on 2026-11-12 | Same | Matches |
| 2025 year-end adj close $186.06; YTD −10.68% | 186.0646; −10.68% | Matches |
| 2026 adj high $239.24, adj low $164.79, drawdown −30.5% | 239.24, 164.7933, −30.53% | Values match; I did not verify the 2026-10-06 and 2026-03-30 dates |
| Latest session move −4.34% | 173.73 → 166.19 = −4.34% | Matches |
| No news, filings, or web access in our sources | `market` holds only OHLCV and company stats — no text, filings, or news fields | Matches |

I could not check t1's 52-week range ($164.27–$243.37), revenue ($302,970,011,648), profit margin (63.66%), 1-month return (−24.90%), or 1-year return (−13.76%), as I didn't query those columns. On the user's news question, we have nothing: no source in this database covers NVIDIA headlines, and we won't guess.

args.query: SELECT s.ticker, s.currency, s.market_cap, s.eps, s.trailing_pe, s.forward_pe, s.updated_at AS profile_updated_at, p.trade_date, p.close, round((p.close / NULLIF(s.eps,0))::numeric,2) AS pe_from_latest_close_and_eps, round((p.close / NULLIF(s.forward_pe,0))::numeric,4) AS implied_forward_eps, round((p.close / NULLIF(s.trailing_pe,0))::numeric,4) AS implied_trailing_eps FROM market.stocks s LEFT JOIN market.daily_prices p ON p.ticker = s.ticker AND p.trade_date = (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM market.daily_prices) WHERE s.ticker IN ('NVDA','AAPL','MSFT','AMZN','GOOGL','META','TSLA','JPM','XOM','WMT') ORDER BY s.ticker;
SELECT min(updated_at) AS min_profile_updated_at, max(updated_at) AS max_profile_updated_at, count(*) AS n, count(forward_pe) AS n_forward_pe, count(market_cap) AS n_mcap FROM market.stocks;

SELECT count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT ticker) AS n_tickers, min(trade_date) AS min_d, max(trade_date) AS max_d, count(*) FILTER (WHERE trade_date > DATE '2026-11-11') AS rows_after_profile_date, count(DISTINCT ticker) FILTER (WHERE trade_date > DATE '2026-11-11') AS tickers_after_profile_date FROM market.daily_prices;

p12 AS (SELECT ticker, close AS c12 FROM market.daily_prices WHERE trade_date = DATE '2026-11-12')
SELECT count(*) AS n,
 round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.c11 / NULLIF(s.eps,0) / NULLIF(s.trailing_pe,0))::numeric,4) AS median_ratio_close11_over_eps_vs_trailpe,
 round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p12.c12 / NULLIF(s.eps,0) / NULLIF(s.trailing_pe,0))::numeric,4) AS median_ratio_close12_over_eps_vs_trailpe,

FROM market.stocks s JOIN p ON p.ticker = s.ticker AND p.rn = 1 JOIN p12 ON p12.ticker = s.ticker
WHERE s.eps > 0 AND s.trailing_pe > 0;

FINDINGS:
- Checked the disputed figure: $4.078T is the 11 Nov 2026 close value, not 12 Nov — StatMuse lists 11 Nov close $173.73 × 23,474,280,728 shares = $4,078,186,790,875. [source: Nvda Stock Market Cap 2026 | StatMuse Money | https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/nvda-stock-market-cap-2026]
- StatMuse's same table shows 10 Nov close $168.89 → $3,964,571,272,151.92, so its series is one day stale and never struck 12 Nov. [source: Nvda Stock Market Cap 2026 | StatMuse Money | https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/nvda-stock-market-cap-2026]
- 12 Nov 2026 close was $166.19, down $7.54 (-4.34%) from $173.73, after a ~14% intraday plunge to $148.80; volume 747.97M vs 131.49M average. [source: NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) Stock Price, News, Quote & History - Yahoo Finance | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA | passage: https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA#:~:text=Regular%20market%20price:%20166.19,of%202026%2D11%2D12%2021:00%20UTC]
- Applying Nvidia's SEC-filing share count (24.1B, 10-Q cover dated 21 Aug 2026) to the 12 Nov close gives ≈$4.00T; StockTitan states it outright. [source: Stocks Closed Slightly Lower in the Stock Market Today, November 12, 2026, and Nvidia Said CEO Jensen Huang Resigned | https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026 | passage: https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026#:~:text=Nvidia%2C%20its%20$166.19%20close%2C%20about%20$4.0%20trillion]
- StockTitan's intraday version of the same math: $163.94 × 24.1B ≈ $3.95T at 3:02 p.m. ET on 12 Nov. [source: Stocks Closed Slightly Lower in the Stock Market Today, November 12, 2026, and Nvidia Said CEO Jensen Huang Resigned | https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026 | passage: https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026#:~:text=Nvidia%2C%20$163.94%20times%2024.1,of%20August%2021%2C%202026]
- So the true 12 Nov close market cap is ≈$3.95–4.01T depending on share count (24.1B SEC cover vs 24.15B data vendors), not $3.954T-as-of-12-Nov and not $4.078T. [source: NVIDIA (NVDA) Statistics & Valuation | https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvda/statistics | passage: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvda/statistics#:~:text=NVIDIA%20has%2024.15%20billion%20shares%20outstanding]
- Yahoo Finance quote page shows market cap $4,012,989,743,104 at the 12 Nov close, plus a separate "non diluted market cap" of $4,195,058,310,000. [source: NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) Stock Price, News, Quote & History - Yahoo Finance | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA]
- CoinGlass also puts 12 Nov close market cap at ≈$4.01T on price $166.19. [source: NVIDIA (NVDA) Stock Price Today, Pre-Market & After-Hours | CoinGlass | https://www.coinglass.com/stocks/NVDA | passage: https://www.coinglass.com/stocks/NVDA#:~:text=NVIDIA%20Corporation%20has%20a,capitalization%20of%20approximately%20$4.01T]
- The $3.954T figure is FinanceCharts' own snapshot paired with its 12 Nov YTD row; its share-count basis is not disclosed, so it is ~1.5% below the SEC-count value. [source: NVIDIA (NVDA) Total Return YTD, TTM, 3Y, 5Y, 10Y, 20Y | https://www.financecharts.com/stocks/NVDA/performance/total-return]
- Recommendation: report "just under/around $4.0T (≈$3.95–4.01T) at the 12 Nov 2026 close"; do not report $4.078T, which is struck at the 11 Nov close of $173.73.
- Corroborating the level: CNBC said the stock "hovered just under $4 trillion in market cap" on 12 Nov after paring a >10% drop. [source: Stock market news for Nov. 12, 2026 | https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/stock-market-today-live-updates.html | passage: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/stock-market-today-live-updates.html#:~:text=The%20stock%20hovered%20just,trillion%20in%20market%20cap]
- Bloomberg/Business Times framed it as market cap falling "below US$4 trillion for the first time since 2025," with as much as $601B erased at the -14% low. [source: Nvidia's market value sinks below US$4 trillion after CEO Jensen Huang resigns - The Business Times | https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/companies-markets/nvidias-market-value-sinks-below-us4-trillion-after-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns]
- Year-to-date: total return -10.68% as of 12 Nov 2026 (TTM -14.04%, 30-day -27.28%); price-only 2026 return -9.44% as of the 10 Nov close (slickcharts, not dividend-adjusted). [source: NVIDIA (NVDA) Total Return YTD, TTM, 3Y, 5Y, 10Y, 20Y | https://www.financecharts.com/stocks/NVDA/performance/total-return]
- Prior 2026 gains: +19% YTD at $225 on 25 Sep 2026 and ~+17% YTD on 27 Oct 2026; record close $239.24 on 6 Oct 2026, intraday 52-week high $243.37. [source: NVDA Annual Returns by Year | https://www.slickcharts.com/symbol/NVDA/returns]
- Sixth straight weekly loss, ~$1.6T of value gone — longest losing streak since 2012; stock ~31% below its record close. [source: Stocks Closed Slightly Lower in the Stock Market Today, November 12, 2026, and Nvidia Said CEO Jensen Huang Resigned | https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026 | passage: https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026#:~:text=Nvidia%20about%2031%25%20below,on%20October%206%2C%202026]
- 12 Nov 2026: "Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately"; CFO Colette Kress interim CEO (keeps CFO role), Harvey C. Jones first-ever board chair. [source: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition#:~:text=Jensen%20Huang%20has%20resigned,the%20Board%2C%20effective%20immediately]
- 8 Nov 2026 board statement: independent investigation by a committee of independent directors with outside counsel into reporting Huang "has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort." [source: Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors#:~:text=the%20target%20of%20a%20foreign%20intelligence%20effort]
- Trigger: WSJ/NYT/FT reporting on two extramarital affairs, one with a woman US intelligence concluded was a Chinese spy; Reuters reported a relationship with a second Nvidia employee. [source: Nvidia shares plunge amid reports board to discuss CEO Huang’s future | Technology News | Al Jazeera | https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/12/nvidia-shares-plunge-amid-reports-board-to-discuss-ceo-huangs-future | passage: https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/11/12/nvidia-shares-plunge-amid-reports-board-to-discuss-ceo-huangs-future#:~:text=Huang%20has%20admitted%20to,with%20a%20Chinese%20executive]
- 13 Nov: Elon Musk said hiring Huang "would be an honor"; Fortune reports Nvidia lost $450B of market value in the days after Huang admitted the affair. [source: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia. Elon Musk says hiring him would be 'an honor' | Fortune | https://fortune.com/2026/11/13/jensen-huang-nvidia-elon-musk-hire-honor | passage: https://fortune.com/2026/11/13/jensen-huang-nvidia-elon-musk-hire-honor#:~:text=Nvidia%20lost%20$450%20billion,admitted%20to%20an%20affair]
- 13 Nov: Asian shares fell on the fallout; Nvidia's Asian supply chain (TSMC, SK hynix, Samsung) preparing for "life after Huang"; forward PE ~12x, cheapest since 2012 per Reuters. [source: Nvidia’s Asian supply chain prepares for life after Huang | The Asahi Shimbun: Breaking News, Japan News and Analysis | https://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/17047366 | passage: https://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/17047366#:~:text=The%20chips%20Nvidia%20will%20ship%20over%20the%20next]
- Analyst moves: Bernstein cut its target to $200 from $400; Citigroup's Atif Malik and Papa Sylla cut to $225 from $285. [source: Nvidia Is Back Below $4 Trillion, and Microsoft Just Passed It | https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-back-below-4-trillion-141310709.html | passage: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-back-below-4-trillion-141310709.html#:~:text=Bernstein%20slashed%20its%20NVIDIA,to%20$200%20from%20$400]
- Wedbush's Dan Ives: worth $300/share with Huang as CEO, $225 without. [source: Stock market news for Nov. 12, 2026 | https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/stock-market-today-live-updates.html | passage: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/stock-market-today-live-updates.html#:~:text=We%20believe%20Nvidia%27s%20value,without%20Jensen%20as%20CEO]
- Q3 FY2027 results still due Tue 17 Nov 2026 after the US close (~1:20 p.m. PT release, 2 p.m. PT call), Kress's first as interim CEO; consensus ~$108.8–109B revenue, ~$2.47 adjusted EPS. [source: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition#:~:text=report%20its%20third%2Dquarter%20fiscal,on%20Tuesday%2C%20November%2017]
- Kress plans a company-wide meeting on 18 Nov; three House committee chairs had asked Huang for a closed-door briefing that day. [source: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO: timeline, successor and AI trade impact — TradingView News | https://www.tradingview.com/news/invezz:71ab51687094b:0-jensen-huang-resigns-as-nvidia-ceo-timeline-successor-and-ai-trade-impact | passage: https://www.tradingview.com/news/invezz:71ab51687094b:0-jensen-huang-resigns-as-nvidia-ceo-timeline-successor-and-ai-trade-impact#:~:text=three%20House%20committee%20chairs,briefing%20on%20November%2018]
- GAPS: No single source states a 12 Nov-close market cap to the dollar; the range comes from share-count differences (24.1B SEC cover vs 24.15B vendor). Macrotrends shows $4.187T "as of November 13, 2026" but the page would not load for verification. No permanent CEO successor named, no board statement after 12 Nov, and no published findings from the intelligence probe.

We can settle the $164.27-versus-$148.80 question from our own price data: I recomputed NVDA's 52-week window directly from `market.daily_prices` (252 sessions, 2025-11-12 → 2026-11-12) and the 52-week intraday low is **$148.80, set on 2026-11-12 itself** — $164.27 is the *prior* low, the intraday low of 2026-03-30, which is still what the profile table carries because that row was last refreshed before the 12 Nov session.

**My recomputation (source: `market.daily_prices`, all USD, end-of-day, window 2025-11-12 → 2026-11-12)**

| Metric | Value | As of (trade_date) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 52-week intraday low | **$148.80** | 2026-11-12 |
| 52-week lowest close | **$165.17** (adj $164.79) | 2026-03-30 |
| Prior 52-week intraday low | $164.27 | 2026-03-30 |
| 52-week intraday high | $243.37 | 2026-10-06 |
| 52-week highest close | $239.24 | 2026-10-06 |
| 2026-11-12 session | open $151.01 / high $167.14 / low $148.80 / close $166.19 | 2026-11-12 |
| 2026-11-12 volume | 742,789,000 (≈5.7× the 131.1M 3-month average) | 2026-11-12 |
| Last lower low before this | $135.40 | 2025-06-02 |
| `market.stocks.week52_low` / `week52_high` | $164.27 / $243.37 | updated_at 2026-11-11 13:39 UTC |

**How the inputs compare with my source**

| Input | Their value | My finding |
| --- | --- | --- |
| t2: intraday low $148.80, 52-week range $148.80–$243.37 | $148.80 | Confirmed — matches my recomputation exactly |
| t1: 52-week range $164.27 – $243.37 | $164.27 low | Does not match through 2026-11-12; that is the stale profile value (as of 2026-11-11), superseded by $148.80 |
| t2: "lowest since June 2025" | June 2025 | Confirmed — last lower intraday low was $135.40 on 2025-06-02 |
| t2: volume 747.7M vs ~131.1M average | 747.7M | Average confirmed (131.1M, 2026-08-12→11-11); my row shows 742,789,000, ~5M below their figure |
| t2: record close $239.24 on 6 Oct, intraday high $243.37 | $239.24 / $243.37 | Confirmed both |
| t2: down ~30% from all-time high | −30% | Confirmed: −30.53% ($239.24 → $166.19) |
| t2: YTD total return −10.68%; price-only −9.44% at 10 Nov | −10.68% / −9.44% | Confirmed on price data: $186.0646 → $166.19 = −10.68%; $186.50 → $168.89 = −9.44% |
| t1: latest close $166.19, −4.34% on the day, 1-month −24.90%, 1-year −13.76%, 2026 closing low $164.79 | as listed | All confirmed against my rows |
| t2: market cap $3.954T | $3.954T | Does not match our profile: $4,078,186,790,912 as of updated_at 2026-11-11, which is struck at the 11 Nov close of $173.73; at the 11-12 close of $166.19 the implied cap is ≈$3.90T (my arithmetic, not a stored figure) |

What we could not check: the news half is outside my sources — I have only the PostgreSQL `market` schema (daily OHLCV and company stats), no news feed or filings, so every headline, the CEO transition, the board probe and the 17 Nov earnings date come from the team's research, not from anything I verified. I also did not verify the "+19% YTD at $225 on 25 Sep 2026" or the 27 Oct figures, and our price data ends at 2026-11-12, so nothing after that date is covered.

t4.text:
We can pin down the as-of dates and what the fields behave like, but not the forward-EPS definition: the `market` schema documents `market_cap` only as "in the stock's currency" and says nothing at all about how `forward_pe` is computed, and there is no forward-EPS column anywhere in the database, so which estimate (current FY, next FY, or next-twelve-months) sits behind it is undocumented and not recoverable from our sources.

| Field | What our source actually says | As-of | What I verified |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `market_cap` | Schema comment: "market_cap and revenue are in the stock's currency." No formula given. | `updated_at` 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC, identical for all 200 rows | Behaves like shares outstanding × share price: dividing by the 2026-11-11 close implies 15,993,481–23,474,280,728 shares across the 200 tickers. Exact share counts aren't in the schema, so the precise price snapshot can't be confirmed. |
| `forward_pe` | Column name only — no definition, no stated EPS horizon. | `updated_at` 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC | It is price ÷ a *forward* EPS estimate, not the `eps` column: 16 tickers with negative `eps` and NULL `trailing_pe` still carry a positive `forward_pe` (COIN −2.77 → 54.71; INTC −2.35 → 32.47; NET −0.67 → 165.35), and 3 are negative where the forward estimate itself is negative (MRNA −58.65, RBLX −40.19, RIVN −7.76). `forward_pe` < `trailing_pe` for 165 of 200. |
| Price data | `daily_prices`, end-of-day OHLCV, 248,236 rows, 200 tickers, 2021-11-11 → 2026-11-12 | Latest `trade_date` 2026-11-12 (199 of 200 tickers have that session) | The multiples are stamped one session *before* the latest close, so they are stale relative to 2026-11-12 prices. |

Two caveats on internal consistency. First, `trailing_pe` is not exactly reproducible from the same row: close(2026-11-11) ÷ `eps` lands within 0.05 of `trailing_pe` for only 33 of 200 tickers, with a median ratio of 1.0204 (1.0183 using the 2026-11-12 close) — roughly a 2% mismatch. Second, for NVDA the forward P/E of 10.6042 implies a forward EPS of about $15.67 using the 2026-11-12 close of $166.19, or $16.38 using the 2026-11-11 close of $173.73, against trailing `eps` of $7.91; that $15.67–$16.38 figure is my arithmetic, not a stored value.

Checking the other input (t1) against my queries:

| t1 claim | My value | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Market cap $4,078,186,790,912, updated_at 2026-11-11 | Same, USD | Matches |
| Trailing / forward P/E 21.35 / 10.60, updated_at 2026-11-11 | 21.3515 / 10.6042, updated_at 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC | Matches |
| Latest close $166.19 on 2026-11-12 | Same | Matches |
| 2025 year-end adj close $186.06; YTD −10.68% | 186.0646; −10.68% | Matches |
| 2026 adj high $239.24, adj low $164.79, drawdown −30.5% | 239.24, 164.7933, −30.53% | Values match; I did not verify the 2026-10-06 and 2026-03-30 dates |
| Latest session move −4.34% | 173.73 → 166.19 = −4.34% | Matches |
| No news, filings, or web access in our sources | `market` holds only OHLCV and company stats — no text, filings, or news fields | Matches |

I could not check t1's 52-week range ($164.27–$243.37), revenue ($302,970,011,648), profit margin (63.66%), 1-month return (−24.90%), or 1-year return (−13.76%), as I didn't query those columns. On the user's news question, we have nothing: no source in this database covers NVIDIA headlines, and we won't guess.

args.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trade_date, close, adj_close
  FROM market.daily_prices
  WHERE ticker = 'NVDA'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d) AS latest_date,
  (SELECT close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_close,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM d WHERE trade_date <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS ytd_start_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM d WHERE trade_date <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS ytd_start_adj,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT adj_close FROM d WHERE trade_date <= '2025-12-31' ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) - 1) * 100::numeric, 2)) AS ytd_return_pct,
  (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d WHERE trade_date >= date_trunc('year', (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM d))::date) AS first_trade_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS first_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT adj_close FROM d ORDER BY trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) - 1) * 100::numeric, 2)) AS since_first_avail_pct,
  (SELECT min(trade_date) FROM d) AS data_start

args.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trade_date, adj_close
  FROM market.daily_prices
  WHERE ticker = 'NVDA'
    AND trade_date <= '2026-11-12'
    AND extract(year FROM trade_date) >= 2025
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT trade_date, adj_close,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn_desc,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY trade_date ASC)  AS rn_asc
  FROM d
)
SELECT
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)  AS latest_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)  AS latest_adj,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 2)  AS prior_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 2)  AS prior_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 2)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS one_day_pct,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 22) AS one_month_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 22) AS one_month_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 22)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS one_month_pct,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 253) AS one_year_date,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 253) AS one_year_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 253)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS one_year_pct,
  (SELECT trade_date FROM ranked WHERE rn_asc = 1) AS earliest_in_window,
  (SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_asc = 1) AS earliest_adj,
  (SELECT round(((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_desc = 1)::numeric
                 / NULLIF((SELECT adj_close FROM ranked WHERE rn_asc = 1)::numeric, 0) - 1) * 100, 2)) AS since_earliest_pct,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ranked) AS trading_days_in_window

1. Plan 2–4 focused queries before searching: the core question, plus the angles a good answer needs (numbers, dates, who/what, opposing views).
2. Use the web search tool (`tavily_tavily_search`). Search in English, and also in Vietnamese when the topic is about Vietnam or the user writes Vietnamese.
3. For news or anything that changes, prefer recent results and note each result's date. Say "as of <date>" in the finding.
4. When a result looks important but its snippet is thin, read the page with the extract tool (`tavily_tavily_extract`) instead of guessing from the snippet. Extract at most 2–3 pages.
5. Prefer primary or reputable sources (official sites, filings, major outlets, papers) over blogs and forums. When sources disagree, record both, each with its source.
6. Stop once the question is covered. Don't keep searching for marginal details, because every search costs a step.
7. Every finding gets the source id of the page it came from (not the site's home page) and a quote copied from that page's result.

history.text:
We can pin down the as-of dates and what the fields behave like, but not the forward-EPS definition: the `market` schema documents `market_cap` only as "in the stock's currency" and says nothing at all about how `forward_pe` is computed, and there is no forward-EPS column anywhere in the database, so which estimate (current FY, next FY, or next-twelve-months) sits behind it is undocumented and not recoverable from our sources.

| Field | What our source actually says | As-of | What I verified |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `market_cap` | Schema comment: "market_cap and revenue are in the stock's currency." No formula given. | `updated_at` 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC, identical for all 200 rows | Behaves like shares outstanding × share price: dividing by the 2026-11-11 close implies 15,993,481–23,474,280,728 shares across the 200 tickers. Exact share counts aren't in the schema, so the precise price snapshot can't be confirmed. |
| `forward_pe` | Column name only — no definition, no stated EPS horizon. | `updated_at` 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC | It is price ÷ a *forward* EPS estimate, not the `eps` column: 16 tickers with negative `eps` and NULL `trailing_pe` still carry a positive `forward_pe` (COIN −2.77 → 54.71; INTC −2.35 → 32.47; NET −0.67 → 165.35), and 3 are negative where the forward estimate itself is negative (MRNA −58.65, RBLX −40.19, RIVN −7.76). `forward_pe` < `trailing_pe` for 165 of 200. |
| Price data | `daily_prices`, end-of-day OHLCV, 248,236 rows, 200 tickers, 2021-11-11 → 2026-11-12 | Latest `trade_date` 2026-11-12 (199 of 200 tickers have that session) | The multiples are stamped one session *before* the latest close, so they are stale relative to 2026-11-12 prices. |

Two caveats on internal consistency. First, `trailing_pe` is not exactly reproducible from the same row: close(2026-11-11) ÷ `eps` lands within 0.05 of `trailing_pe` for only 33 of 200 tickers, with a median ratio of 1.0204 (1.0183 using the 2026-11-12 close) — roughly a 2% mismatch. Second, for NVDA the forward P/E of 10.6042 implies a forward EPS of about $15.67 using the 2026-11-12 close of $166.19, or $16.38 using the 2026-11-11 close of $173.73, against trailing `eps` of $7.91; that $15.67–$16.38 figure is my arithmetic, not a stored value.

Checking the other input (t1) against my queries:

| t1 claim | My value | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Market cap $4,078,186,790,912, updated_at 2026-11-11 | Same, USD | Matches |
| Trailing / forward P/E 21.35 / 10.60, updated_at 2026-11-11 | 21.3515 / 10.6042, updated_at 2026-11-11 13:39:07 UTC | Matches |
| Latest close $166.19 on 2026-11-12 | Same | Matches |
| 2025 year-end adj close $186.06; YTD −10.68% | 186.0646; −10.68% | Matches |
| 2026 adj high $239.24, adj low $164.79, drawdown −30.5% | 239.24, 164.7933, −30.53% | Values match; I did not verify the 2026-10-06 and 2026-03-30 dates |
| Latest session move −4.34% | 173.73 → 166.19 = −4.34% | Matches |
| No news, filings, or web access in our sources | `market` holds only OHLCV and company stats — no text, filings, or news fields | Matches |

I could not check t1's 52-week range ($164.27–$243.37), revenue ($302,970,011,648), profit margin (63.66%), 1-month return (−24.90%), or 1-year return (−13.76%), as I didn't query those columns. On the user's news question, we have nothing: no source in this database covers NVIDIA headlines, and we won't guess.

We can settle this one: the other agent is right, and my earlier table carried a stale field. I re-ran the window myself — 251 NVDA sessions from 2025-11-13 through the latest trade_date, 2026-11-12 — and the lowest intraday price is $148.80, set on 2026-11-12 itself. The $164.27 in `market.stocks.week52_low` is the 2026-03-30 intraday low, and that profile row was last refreshed at 2026-11-11 13:39 UTC, so it simply predates the 12 Nov session. The profile's `week52_high` of $243.37 does match the window, so only the low is out of date.

One distinction worth keeping straight: $148.80 is the intraday low, while the lowest *closing* level in the window is still $164.79 (adj close, 2026-03-30) — that is the figure my earlier "2026 closing low" row referred to, and it stands.

On the news half, nothing has changed: we have no news feed, filings, or web access here, only the PostgreSQL `market` schema, so we have nothing to report on recent NVIDIA headlines and won't guess.

args.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trade_date, open, high, low, close, adj_close
  FROM market.daily_prices
  WHERE ticker = 'NVDA'
    AND trade_date > (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM market.daily_prices WHERE ticker='NVDA') - INTERVAL '365 days'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM market.daily_prices WHERE ticker='NVDA') AS latest_date,
  (SELECT min(low) FROM d) AS intraday_low_52w,
  (SELECT min(low) FROM d WHERE trade_date >= DATE '2026-01-01') AS intraday_low_2026,
  (SELECT min(adj_close) FROM d) AS adj_close_low_52w,
  (SELECT max(high) FROM d) AS intraday_high_52w,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM d) AS sessions

FINDINGS:
- Checked the disputed figure: $4.078T is the 11 Nov 2026 close value, not 12 Nov — StatMuse lists 11 Nov close $173.73 × 23,474,280,728 shares = $4,078,186,790,875. [source: Nvda Stock Market Cap 2026 | StatMuse Money | https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/nvda-stock-market-cap-2026]
- StatMuse's same table shows 10 Nov close $168.89 → $3,964,571,272,151.92, so its series is one day stale and never struck 12 Nov. [source: Nvda Stock Market Cap 2026 | StatMuse Money | https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/nvda-stock-market-cap-2026]
- 12 Nov 2026 close was $166.19, down $7.54 (-4.34%) from $173.73, after a ~14% intraday plunge to $148.80; volume 747.97M vs 131.49M average. [source: NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) Stock Price, News, Quote & History - Yahoo Finance | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA | passage: https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA#:~:text=Regular%20market%20price:%20166.19,of%202026%2D11%2D12%2021:00%20UTC]
- Applying Nvidia's SEC-filing share count (24.1B, 10-Q cover dated 21 Aug 2026) to the 12 Nov close gives ≈$4.00T; StockTitan states it outright. [source: Stocks Closed Slightly Lower in the Stock Market Today, November 12, 2026, and Nvidia Said CEO Jensen Huang Resigned | https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026 | passage: https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026#:~:text=Nvidia%2C%20its%20$166.19%20close%2C%20about%20$4.0%20trillion]
- StockTitan's intraday version of the same math: $163.94 × 24.1B ≈ $3.95T at 3:02 p.m. ET on 12 Nov. [source: Stocks Closed Slightly Lower in the Stock Market Today, November 12, 2026, and Nvidia Said CEO Jensen Huang Resigned | https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026 | passage: https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-november-12-2026#:~:text=Nvidia%2C%20$163.94%20times%2024.1,of%20August%2021%2C%202026]
- So the true 12 Nov close market cap is ≈$3.95–4.01T depending on share count (24.1B SEC cover vs 24.15B data vendors), not $3.954T-as-of-12-Nov and not $4.078T. [source: NVIDIA (NVDA) Statistics & Valuation | https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvda/statistics | passage: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvda/statistics#:~:text=NVIDIA%20has%2024.15%20billion%20shares%20outstanding]
- Yahoo Finance quote page shows market cap $4,012,989,743,104 at the 12 Nov close, plus a separate "non diluted market cap" of $4,195,058,310,000. [source: NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) Stock Price, News, Quote & History - Yahoo Finance | https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA]
- CoinGlass also puts 12 Nov close market cap at ≈$4.01T on price $166.19. [source: NVIDIA (NVDA) Stock Price Today, Pre-Market & After-Hours | CoinGlass | https://www.coinglass.com/stocks/NVDA | passage: https://www.coinglass.com/stocks/NVDA#:~:text=NVIDIA%20Corporation%20has%20a,capitalization%20of%20approximately%20$4.01T]
- The $3.954T figure is FinanceCharts' own snapshot paired with its 12 Nov YTD row; its share-count basis is not disclosed, so it is ~1.5% below the SEC-count value. [source: NVIDIA (NVDA) Total Return YTD, TTM, 3Y, 5Y, 10Y, 20Y | https://www.financecharts.com/stocks/NVDA/performance/total-return]
- Recommendation: report "just under/around $4.0T (≈$3.95–4.01T) at the 12 Nov 2026 close"; do not report $4.078T, which is struck at the 11 Nov close of $173.73.
- Corroborating the level: CNBC said the stock "hovered just under $4 trillion in market cap" on 12 Nov after paring a >10% drop. [source: Stock market news for Nov. 12, 2026 | https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/stock-market-today-live-updates.html | passage: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/stock-market-today-live-updates.html#:~:text=The%20stock%20hovered%20just,trillion%20in%20market%20cap]

Elon Musk says hiring him would be 'an honor' | Fortune | https://fortune.com/2026/11/13/jensen-huang-nvidia-elon-musk-hire-honor | passage: https://fortune.com/2026/11/13/jensen-huang-nvidia-elon-musk-hire-honor#:~:text=Nvidia%20lost%20$450%20billion,admitted%20to%20an%20affair]

- Wedbush's Dan Ives: worth $300/share with Huang as CEO, $225 without. [source: Stock market news for Nov. 12, 2026 | https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/stock-market-today-live-updates.html | passage: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/stock-market-today-live-updates.html#:~:text=We%20believe%20Nvidia%27s%20value,without%20Jensen%20as%20CEO]
- Q3 FY2027 results still due Tue 17 Nov 2026 after the US close (~1:20 p.m. PT release, 2 p.m. PT call), Kress's first as interim CEO; consensus ~$108.8–109B revenue, ~$2.47 adjusted EPS. [source: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition | NVIDIA Newsroom | https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition | passage: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition#:~:text=report%20its%20third%2Dquarter%20fiscal,on%20Tuesday%2C%20November%2017]
- Kress plans a company-wide meeting on 18 Nov; three House committee chairs had asked Huang for a closed-door briefing that day. [source: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO: timeline, successor and AI trade impact — TradingView News | https://www.tradingview.com/news/invezz:71ab51687094b:0-jensen-huang-resigns-as-nvidia-ceo-timeline-successor-and-ai-trade-impact | passage: https://www.tradingview.com/news/invezz:71ab51687094b:0-jensen-huang-resigns-as-nvidia-ceo-timeline-successor-and-ai-trade-impact#:~:text=three%20House%20committee%20chairs,briefing%20on%20November%2018]
- GAPS: No single source states a 12 Nov-close market cap to the dollar; the range comes from share-count differences (24.1B SEC cover vs 24.15B vendor). Macrotrends shows $4.187T "as of November 13, 2026" but the page would not load for verification. No permanent CEO successor named, no board statement after 12 Nov, and no published findings from the intelligence probe.
